answer: Sea's e-commerce (Shopee) cost of revenue rose 38.6%, from US$5.2 billion in 2023 to US$7.2 billion in 2024. This increase was primarily driven by higher logistics costs, which in turn reflected a 33.0% surge in order volume — from 8.2 billion orders in 2023 to 10.9 billion orders in 2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.102, 103].
